node.title: Anticode/EKR toolkit for exchange-distance independence — with the honest spectral scoping
node.statement: Instantiate Delsarte/Frankl-Wilson anticode bounds on J(n,j): sets of locators pairwise exchange-distance > s have size <= C(n-s, j-s)-type bounds — factors (j/n)^s relative to C(n,j). SCOPING NEGATIVE (included): the Johnson gap n is tiny vs degree ~n^2/4, so single-step expander mixing is near-vacuous, and pure combinatorial distance bounds CANNOT reach q-power (FM) scales — the q-scale input must be algebraic (v8 per-locator cap, exchange residual systems). Prevents doomed naive-EML attempts.
node.notes: PARTIALLY DELIVERED in flight: PR #191's Johnson exchange-mixing lemma proves the single-step bound with the predicted (1 - n/(j(n-j))) factor TIGHT (point-dictators attain equality) plus the geometric endpoint decay lambda*^s — the spectral half of this toolkit.
